title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 41
text:
93. It can help during any case management hearing to:
• Tell them, particularly in civil proceedings, that the role of the court is dispute resolution.
Explain forms of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) as appropriate.
• Ask them whether they have tried to resolve their differences by negotiation and, if
possible, spell out the best- and worst-possible outcomes at the outset.
• Suggest they get one-off advice on the strength and value of their case.
• If a mediation is held, suggest they bring along a friend who has no vested interest in the
outcome to discuss things with and offer support. In some jurisdictions, explain that the
friend may not be allowed to sit in during the mediation itself.
• It is useful to remind LIPs to tell the court in advance of the hearing if their case has been
settled.
